name: MEGA UDPOS
description: Universal Dependencies POS tagging as part of the MEGA benchmark suite. A multilingual part-of-speech tagging dataset based on Universal Dependencies treebanks, utilizing the universal POS tag set of 17 tags across 38 diverse languages from different language families. Used for evaluating multilingual POS tagging systems.
typical_sota_score: ~90–97% (frontier multilingual models on high-resource languages; lower on low-resource)
reputation: Part of the MEGA (Massively Multilingual Evaluation) benchmark suite by Microsoft Research; covers 38 languages including low-resource languages; important for evaluating multilingual model generalization
notes: Part of MEGA (ACL 2023). Universal Dependencies POS tagging across 38 languages using 17-tag universal tagset. Tests generalization of multilingual models to diverse morphological systems. Includes multiple language families: Indo-European, Semitic, Turkic, Sino-Tibetan, and others.
